svg.text: LOCOMOTIVE — wiring diagram rev D · 2S (2× XTAR 14500) + XIAO ESP32-C5 + DRV8833
Every wire has a number (L1…L29) matching the wire list. Filled dot = connection. Crossing without a dot = NO connection. Thick line = motor current, AWG20.
No nSLEEP/nFAULT control: nothing is soldered on the module. EEP is tied to 3V3 (L17), ULT is left floating. Firmware: HAVE_NSLEEP 0 and HAVE_NFAULT 0.

at the far end is both the series link and
the tap point for MID. AWG20.

1. SW1 OFF while charging AND while flashing. The charger sits on the pack permanently; with a load attached it counts the quiescent current and never terminates the charge cycle.
2. The BM balance tap must be wired, even though both cells are individually protected. Without BM the IP2326 does not balance and one cell runs ahead.

3. Set the buck to 5.0 V using an ADJUSTABLE MP1584EN. The 5V pin of the XIAO feeds the on-board SGM40567, which wants to see ~4.5–5.5 V, so 4.6 V is too tight. A fixed Mini-560 is out: it no longer reaches 5 V below ≈6.5 V input.

4. On the C5, D0 (GPIO1) is the ONLY ADC on the header, so the pack voltage divider has to go there. Motor control therefore moves to D4/D5: IN1/IN2 are digital inputs (PWM square wave) and can sit on any GPIO.
5. D2 (GPIO25) and D3 (GPIO7) are strapping pins on the C5 — leave them free and never hang a pull-up or pull-down on them. D6/D7 are the UART: keep free for the boot log and serial debug.
6. C3/C4 are HF decoupling for the H-bridge, not a brownout buffer: at 1 A, 100 µF holds the voltage for only ~100 µs per volt. Brownout is solved by the buck choice and the low-battery threshold.

7. SW1: the SS12D00 is rated 0.3–0.5 A and carries the full motor current here (0.7–1 A stalled) plus the inrush of C3. Use a switch rated ≥2 A, or have it drive a P-MOSFET load switch. Add a 2 A fuse directly after SW1.

8. This module: EEP = nSLEEP, ULT = nFAULT (mangled silkscreen), channel A = IN1/IN2 → OUT1/OUT2. With the module disconnected, MEASURE EEP↔VCC: open or ±47 kΩ → run a wire from 3V3 to EEP (L17). Near 0 Ω → J1 is already closed, wick it off FIRST, otherwise you short 3V3 against the pack.
